usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the `credit <customer> <amount>` command, and `help` now lists it right after `balance <customer>`. Build and `dotnet test` pass (9 of 9). Following DEC-B02, any credit above the balance leaves the balance at 0.00 and is held as refundable credit, which nothing applies automatically. Everything is committed with the report in `.work/report.json`.

Two open questions are recorded for Finance. Credit is held per customer, not put against specific invoices, so a credited invoice can still get a late fee. Also, no command shows or releases refundable credit yet.

OUTCOME: completed
